meta.dose_note: The 80:10:10 cell carries 819 conflict rows in EACH direction against the one-sided cells' 164, so it is 5x the per-side dose: the 2% cells bracket the two label directions, they are not a dose-matched control for either half of the mix, and the 80:10:10 point is not predicted to sit between them.
meta.eval_backend_note: The 80:10:10 and 2% rows are one release: same published step-96 Dolci parents, 8,192 rows x 2 epochs, batch 32, seed 42, campaign training templates, and the same glm-aft-graphs-splitk1-v1 eval backend. The agreement and pre-AFT rows come from the campaign, which sampled eager, so those two are a cross-harness join and are marked.
